author: /root
objective: Medir exploratoriamente o efeito incremental do Bateia como catalisador quando a IA de ambos os braços também pode pesquisar diretamente na internet.
estimand: Delta de qualidade, novidade sustentada, direcionamento e eficiência entre IA+internet e IA+internet+Bateia sob o mesmo caso, modelo, esforço, limite de pesquisas web, tempo e schema.

frozen_inputs.execution_order_rule: Odd first hexadecimal nibble executes treatment first; even executes control first.

control.instruction_delta: Pesquise diretamente na internet quando isso puder reduzir incerteza e conclua com evidências rastreáveis.

treatment.required_order: Call bateia_recommend before the first native web search, then use native web search to confirm, reject or deepen the directions returned by Bateia.
treatment.instruction_delta: Use uma consulta ao Bateia como orientação inicial; depois pesquise diretamente na internet para verificar, rejeitar ou aprofundar suas direções.

common_execution.live_web_temporal_window: Execute starts in the same local experiment window; live web is not claimed byte-identical.
common_execution.evidence_rule: A public-web claim must carry a direct locator. A Bateia result remains INCONCLUSIVE when its own evidence is empty, but INCONCLUSIVE is not an automatic loss if it safely redirects, narrows or terminates downstream web research.

primary_dimensions: decision-relevant findings with resolvable public support
novel supported alternatives mechanisms or hypotheses
catalysis_dimensions_after_reveal: Bateia direction visibly changed or focused a later web query
Bateia-seeded direction was confirmed or rejected by public web evidence
useful supported findings per native web call
total retrieval overhead including Bateia expansion and candidate assessment
evaluation.winner_policy: Declare treatment uplift only when the blinded final-output comparison favors treatment and the post-reveal trace establishes at least one concrete catalytic path. Otherwise report tie, no demonstrated catalysis or harm as observed.

stop_conditions: Stop after exactly one valid pair.
Stop without replacement on invalid output, budget breach, missing terminal exit code, overlap or infrastructure failure after a behavioral message.
Do not alter prompts, rubric or case after the first session starts.
